title: Study Evaluating Safety and Tolerability of Vabicaserin in Patients With Sudden Worsening of Schizophrenia
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the clinical safety and tolerability of vabicaserin in Japanese subjects that have a sudden worsening of their symptoms of schizophrenia. The study will also assess the efficacy of vabicaserin and compare it to risperidone.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male and female subjects between \>=20 and =\<65 years of age
* Current diagnosis and DSM-IV-TR diagnosis of schizophrenia type (295.10, 295.30 and 295.90)
* Total PANSS score \>=70 and =\< 120

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who are hospitalized against their will
* Current Axis I primary psychiatric diagnosis other than schizophrenia
* A score of 3 on CDSS question 8 which pertains to suicide
